$comment: GENERATED from libs/soup-door/src/writeback.rs. Do not edit; a test keeps the two the same.

cut.why: a note stored before the 1,000-character bound reads back cut to 1,000 (named in the read's `truncated`); written back, the shorter note is what lands

cut.key: body, handle and other text fields
cut.why: a read bounded by `max_chars` cuts long fields and names them in `truncated`; read again with a larger bound before writing a record back

description: Writing back a record read from the soup (soup_get, cauldron soup get) with soup_put or cauldron soup import. `ignored`: keys reads add, which every record write drops and names in its answer's `ignored` list. `refused`: keys a write refuses, which a client strips itself before writing back. `cut`: what a read may have shortened.

ignored.why: computed by reads from the `supersedes` edges pointing at the record; to supersede, write a new record with a `supersedes` edge
computed by reads: a record a ripple wrote that the owner has not approved or rejected
the top-level `rejected: true` reads add to a record the owner rejected (the flag itself is `meta.rejected`, which is refused); dropped only when it is `true`, as reads write it

computed by reads from the transaction that created the record: the merge that carried it there and where it came from (`cauldron merge`); the record's own provenance is `meta.merged_from`, which is refused
computed by reads from the cluster's `claims` edges, with each region's handle; a claim is written as a `claims` edge or with soup_claim

refused.why: the owner's review flag, set only by the owner's decision (`cauldron ripples approve`, `cauldron soup approve` at a terminal, or, where the owner opened approving to agents, those commands without one and the MCP tool `soup_approve`), never by a record write; refused in any casing, set or null

the owner's rejection flag, set only by the owner's decision (`cauldron ripples reject` at a terminal, or, where the owner opened approving to agents, without one and the MCP tool `soup_reject`), never by a record write; refused in any casing, set or null
ripple provenance, stamped by the door on the records a ripple writes and only there (refused: ripple_provenance)

merge provenance (where a record came from, who wrote it there, the decision a merge carried), written only by `cauldron merge` on the records it carries; refused in any casing, dotted or nested, anywhere a record write, a link, a claim, a cite or a ripple's batch carries it (refused: merged_from)

a write only creates: an id the soup holds is refused (`duplicate_node_id`; under remint, `label-shadows-existing`); give the record a new label (remint) or the next free id, and a `supersedes` edge to the old one if it replaces it
